description: Firmware signing keys by public-key fingerprint (SHA-256 of the DER SubjectPublicKeyInfo). Only public fingerprints belong here; private keys never enter any repository. See docs/firmware-signing-keys.md.

keys.reason: The private key was committed as firmware/pellet_module/pellet_module_key.pem in ff2a61b (2024-11-22) and is public in this repository and its upstream. Anyone can sign images for bootloaders that embed it.

The private key is committed as firmware/magnet_module/magnet_module_key.pem (ff2a61b, 2024-11-22) and is public. The magnet module is not used by reachAQ and still builds with this key; do not ship magnet boards until it is replaced.
